name: 2026 Q3 Internal Security Assessment
scope: Customer-facing web application, primary application database, corporate identity provider, and the internal build server. Assessment covers configuration review, policy review, and interview-based control validation.
assumptions: Findings are based on synthetic sample evidence supplied for this exercise. No live systems were tested, no exploitation was attempted, and no external attack surface scanning was performed.

name: 2026 Q4 Baseline Readiness Review
scope: Early baseline review of asset ownership records, the staging environment, and build server access management. Evidence collection is still in progress.
assumptions: This review is in an early stage. Most controls are not yet assessed and supporting evidence has not been collected, so coverage figures are expected to be low.
